source: The town council of Harrowmere voted 7 to 4 on Tuesday evening to close the Millgate footbridge for repairs starting 3 March. Engineers from Calder & Voss found corrosion in two of the bridge's five support beams during a routine inspection in January. The work is expected to take eleven weeks and cost £420,000, of which the county will pay 60 percent. Councillor Dana Whitlock, who chairs the transport committee, said a temporary shuttle bus will run every 20 minutes between Millgate and the station, but only on weekdays. Local shop owners, led by baker Tomas Reyner, had asked for the closure to be postponed until after Easter; that request was rejected. The bridge carries roughly 3,100 pedestrians a day.

source: Regional carrier Skerry Air announced on Monday that it will suspend its Inverloch to Bergen route from 1 November, citing a 34 percent drop in winter bookings compared with last year. Chief executive Maren Odegaard said the route will return on 28 March if fuel prices stay below the level budgeted for 2026. Passengers who already hold tickets for November through March can choose a full refund or rebooking via Aberdeen at no extra charge. The airline, which operates nine turboprop aircraft, said no jobs will be lost; the two aircraft used on the Bergen route will be moved to its Shetland services. The pilots' union, represented by Callum Fraser, welcomed the job guarantee but criticised the short notice of six weeks.

source: Shares in battery maker Voltanic fell 12 percent on Thursday after the company cut its full-year revenue forecast to between $1.8 billion and $1.9 billion, down from the $2.2 billion it projected in February. Chief financial officer Priya Venkataraman blamed delays at the new plant in Tulsa, where production will now begin in the second quarter of next year rather than this autumn. The company still reported a quarterly profit of $41 million, slightly above analysts' expectations of $38 million. Analyst Gregor Lindqvist of Northbay Securities kept his "hold" rating, saying the delay was "a timing problem, not a demand problem". Voltanic employs about 6,400 people, and it said it has no plans for layoffs.

source: A study of 2,300 secondary school pupils in the Lake Tarnow district found that students who started classes at 9:15 instead of 8:30 slept on average 37 minutes longer on school nights. The trial, run by Dr. Helena Brandt of Tarnow University over the 2024–25 school year, involved six schools; three kept the old timetable as a comparison group. Attendance in the later-start schools rose by 1.9 percentage points, but the researchers found no measurable change in exam results. Brandt cautioned that one year is too short to judge academic effects. The district's education director, Marcus Oyelaran, said the board will decide in June whether to extend the later start to all fourteen of its secondary schools.

source: Supermarket chain Fennick's is recalling its own-brand "Harvest Crunch" granola in 500 g bags after a supplier warned that some batches may contain undeclared almonds. The recall covers bags with best-before dates between 12 August and 30 September; the 1 kg bags are not affected. The company said it had received three reports of mild allergic reactions and no hospitalisations. Customers can return the product to any of Fennick's 212 stores for a full refund, with or without a receipt. Food safety manager Olivia Tran said people without a nut allergy can safely eat the granola. The affected batches were produced at a factory run by Dunmore Mills, which has paused the production line while it investigates.

source: The city of Port Avelin will start charging for parking on Sundays in its central zone from 1 July, ending a free-parking policy that has been in place since 1998. The rate will be €1.50 per hour between 11:00 and 18:00, half the weekday tariff. Residents with a zone permit are exempt. Deputy mayor Ines Carvalho said the measure should raise about €900,000 a year, all of which is earmarked for cycle lanes. The retailers' association, chaired by Bruno Saltzman, opposes the plan and has collected 4,700 signatures against it. The opposition Civic List party voted against, arguing that the charge should have been tested for six months first. The council approved the measure by 19 votes to 12.

source: Software company Lumenfield has agreed to buy the Danish scheduling start-up Tidsplan for $64 million in cash, the two firms said on Wednesday. Tidsplan, founded in 2019 by Astrid Nyholm and Jeppe Krag, makes rota software used by about 1,800 hospitals and care homes. All 85 Tidsplan employees will be offered jobs at Lumenfield, and Nyholm will stay on as head of the healthcare unit for at least two years; Krag will leave after the deal closes. The acquisition still needs approval from the Danish competition authority and is expected to close in the fourth quarter. Lumenfield's chief executive, Robert Achterberg, said Tidsplan's product will keep its name and its Copenhagen office.

source: Heavy rain over the weekend flooded around 140 homes in the village of Sutter's Ford, the regional emergency service said on Monday. The River Enn peaked at 4.6 metres early on Sunday, the highest level since 2007. No one was injured, but 310 residents spent the night in the sports hall of the Ridgeway school. Fire chief Anton Dvorak said pumps brought in from neighbouring Kelby lowered the water level in the main street by Sunday evening. Power was restored to all but 22 homes by Monday noon. The regional governor, Sofia Marchetti, visited the village and promised emergency grants of up to €5,000 per household, to be paid within three weeks to those without flood insurance.

source: The national rail operator Trans-Meridian will introduce a new timetable on 14 December that adds a direct morning train from Castlebrook to the capital, departing at 6:42 and arriving at 8:55. The journey currently requires a change at Ashby Junction and takes 2 hours 50 minutes. To make room, the 7:10 stopping service will no longer call at Little Wenlow, a decision the village's residents' group, led by Miriam Stokes, called "a slap in the face". Ticket prices for the direct train will be the same as for the existing connection.

source: A court in Davenmoor on Friday fined the delivery company QuickHaul £180,000 for breaching working-time rules. Inspectors found that 46 drivers at the firm's Davenmoor depot had regularly worked more than 60 hours a week between March and August last year without the required rest periods. Judge Eleanor Pryce said the company had ignored two written warnings from the labour inspectorate. QuickHaul's lawyer, Stefan Albrecht, said the firm had since hired 20 additional drivers and installed a new shift-planning system, and would not appeal. The union's regional secretary, Nadia Rahman, who filed the original complaint, said the fine was "welcome but small" for a company with annual revenue of £95 million.

source: The Ostrander Museum of Natural History will reopen on Saturday 9 May after a renovation that lasted 26 months, eight months longer than planned. The €31 million project added a glass-roofed atrium and a new gallery for the museum's 12-metre fin whale skeleton, which had been in storage since 2011. Director Yusuf Demirci said admission will be free during the opening weekend, after which adult tickets will cost €14, up from €11 before the closure. Children under 12 continue to enter free. The delay was caused mainly by asbestos discovered in the east wing, according to project manager Katrin Holm. The museum expects 400,000 visitors in its first year, compared with 290,000 in its last full year before closing.

source: Mobile operator Telvara said on Tuesday it will switch off its 3G network in the northern provinces on 30 September, six months ahead of the rest of the country. The company estimates that about 52,000 customers still use phones that only support 3G; they will receive a text message and a letter by the end of June. Customers on a contract can exchange an old handset for a basic 4G phone free of charge, while prepaid customers will get a €30 voucher. Network director Elif Sandoval said the freed-up frequencies will be used to improve 4G coverage in rural areas. The consumer association warned that some older car emergency-call systems and alarm units also depend on 3G.

source: De gemeente Veldhoven aan de Linge heeft dinsdagavond besloten het zwembad De Waterlelie niet te sluiten. Een voorstel van wethouder Joris Hendrickx om het bad per 1 januari dicht te doen, haalde geen meerderheid: 11 raadsleden stemden voor, 14 tegen. Het zwembad kost de gemeente jaarlijks 640.000 euro en heeft een nieuw dak nodig van naar schatting 1,2 miljoen euro. source: Fietsenfabrikant Rijnwiel roept ruim 8.400 elektrische fietsen van het model Stadsloper E3 terug vanwege een mogelijk defect aan de accuhouder. Bij fietsen die tussen februari en juli 2025 zijn verkocht kan de accu tijdens het rijden loskomen. Er zijn tot nu toe negen meldingen binnengekomen, waarvan twee met lichte verwondingen. Het model E4, dat sinds augustus in de winkel ligt, heeft een andere houder en valt buiten de terugroepactie.

source: Het Streekziekenhuis Maasoever opent op maandag 2 juni een nieuwe polikliniek voor slaapstoornissen. source: Die Stadtwerke Hallbruck erhöhen zum 1. Oktober die Preise für Fernwärme um durchschnittlich 8,5 Prozent. Für einen Haushalt mit einem Jahresverbrauch von 12.000 Kilowattstunden bedeutet das Mehrkosten von rund 110 Euro im Jahr. Geschäftsführerin Dr. Katharina Wendel begründete den Schritt mit gestiegenen Kosten für die Sanierung des Leitungsnetzes, in das bis 2028 insgesamt 45 Millionen Euro fließen sollen. Der Grundpreis bleibt unverändert, nur der Arbeitspreis steigt. Die Verbraucherzentrale kritisierte, dass die Kunden erst sechs Wochen vorher informiert wurden. Der Mieterverein unter Vorsitz von Holger Brandstetter fordert einen Härtefallfonds. Zuletzt hatten die Stadtwerke die Preise im Januar 2023 angehoben.

source: La mairie de Saint-Aubrac a annoncé lundi que le marché couvert des Halles fermera du 6 janvier au 28 février pour le remplacement de sa toiture. Les 34 commerçants seront installés sous des chapiteaux chauffés place Gambetta, à deux cents mètres de là, et ne paieront pas de loyer pendant cette période. Le chantier, d'un coût de 1,7 million d'euros, est financé à 40 % par la région. L'adjointe au commerce, Claire Fontenelle, assure que les horaires resteront les mêmes, du mardi au dimanche matin. Le président de l'association des commerçants, Mehdi Roussel, s'inquiète toutefois d'une baisse de fréquentation, la place Gambetta ne disposant que de 25 places de stationnement.

source: Le fabricant de skis Montclar, basé à Vaux-les-Cimes, a présenté jeudi un plan de réduction de sa consommation d'énergie de 30 % d'ici 2028. L'entreprise installera 4 200 mètres carrés de panneaux solaires sur le toit de son usine et remplacera ses deux fours à gaz par des modèles électriques. L'investissement s'élève à 6 millions d'euros, dont 1,5 million de subventions de l'État. La directrice générale, Élodie Marchand, a précisé que les 310 emplois du site seront maintenus. Le délégué syndical Thierry Vasseur a salué le projet tout en demandant que les économies réalisées profitent aussi aux salaires. Montclar produit environ 95 000 paires de skis par an, dont les deux tiers sont exportés.

source: El Ayuntamiento de Villanueva del Arroyo aprobó el jueves la peatonalización de la calle Mayor entre la plaza del Mercado y la iglesia de San Telmo. La medida entrará en vigor el 1 de septiembre y afectará a un tramo de 380 metros. Los vehículos de reparto podrán acceder solo entre las 7:00 y las 10:30. La concejala de Movilidad, Lucía Barrientos, explicó que las obras costarán 850.000 euros y durarán cuatro meses. La asociación de comerciantes, presidida por Ramón Echevarría, apoya el proyecto, aunque pide que se habilite un aparcamiento disuasorio antes de que empiecen las obras. La oposición se abstuvo en la votación, que salió adelante con 13 votos a favor y ninguno en contra.

source: La cooperativa aceitera Olivar del Sur, de Torrealmenar, cerró la campaña con una producción de 14.200 toneladas de aceite de oliva, un 22 % más que el año anterior. Su presidente, Joaquín Montalbán, atribuyó la mejora a las lluvias de primavera y advirtió de que los precios en origen han bajado de 7,80 a 5,10 euros por kilo. La cooperativa, con 1.900 socios, destinará 2 millones de euros a una nueva línea de envasado que estará lista en marzo. La directora comercial, Beatriz Solano, señaló que el 45 % de la producción se exporta, sobre todo a Italia y Japón. Los socios recibirán la liquidación final antes del 30 de junio.

По его словам, при оплате транспортной картой поездка будет стоить 41 рубль. source: Marlowe County Library – Lending Rules. Adult members may borrow up to 20 items at a time; children under 12 may borrow up to 10. Books are lent for three weeks and DVDs for one week. source: Ferncastle Group Speak-Up Policy. source: Regeling hybride werken gemeente Oostervliet, geldig vanaf 1 januari 2026. Medewerkers met een kantoorfunctie mogen maximaal twee dagen per week thuiswerken, na overleg met hun leidinggevende. Dinsdag en donderdag zijn vaste teamdagen waarop iedereen op het gemeentehuis aanwezig is. Voor elke thuiswerkdag ontvangt de medewerker een vergoeding van € 2,40; op die dagen vervalt de reiskostenvergoeding. Een bureaustoel en een beeldscherm kunnen in bruikleen worden aangevraagd bij de afdeling Facilitair. Medewerkers van de publieksbalie en de buitendienst vallen buiten deze regeling. De regeling wordt in oktober 2026 geëvalueerd door de ondernemingsraad en de gemeentesecretaris, de heer Bram Koolhaas.

source: Review digest: Vantor Q7 robot vacuum (1,284 reviews, average 4.3 out of 5). source: What diners say about Saffron Quay, Bristol (4.6 stars from 530 reviews). The lamb biryani is the dish mentioned most often and is repeatedly called the best in the city. source: TrailMarch Ridge GTX hiking boots: summary of 860 customer reviews (average 4.1/5). Sizing is the main issue: the boot runs about half a size small, and buyers with wide feet often returned it. Comfort out of the box is rated highly, with little break-in needed. source: Guest review summary for Casa Limoeiro, Lisbon: 8.7 out of 10 based on 1,145 verified stays. Guests love the breakfast served on the rooftop terrace, with views over the Alfama district, and frequently name the receptionist João for his restaurant tips. The main drawback is noise: rooms facing the street pick up bar noise until about 2 am, while courtyard rooms are reported as quiet. source: Linguabird app – review roundup (App Store, 4.5 stars from about 48,000 ratings). Learners like the short daily lessons and say the streak system keeps them motivated; many report practising for more than 100 days in a row. Spanish and French courses are considered the most complete. The speech recognition is the weak point, especially in the Portuguese course, where correct answers are often marked wrong. Reviews from this year are noticeably more critical: in January the monthly price rose from $6.99 to $9.99, and offline lessons, previously free, are now available only to Premium subscribers. Free users also complain that an ad now plays after every lesson. The developer, Tessel Labs, has promised a speech engine update for the summer.

source: GreenCrate meal kits – Trustpilot summary (3.9 from 2,750 reviews). Customers like the recipes, which mostly take about 30 minutes and use fresh vegetables, and the wide choice of 24 dishes each week. The most frequent complaint concerns the subscription mechanics: a week must be skipped before Wednesday midnight, and many customers who missed the deadline were charged for a box they did not want. Refunds in those cases were given as account credit rather than money back, which angers reviewers. Rural customers report late deliveries, sometimes a full day, leaving chilled items warm. The amount of plastic packaging is criticised, although the cardboard box and ice packs can be returned to the driver.

source: Elevo Pro standing desk: what 640 buyers say (4.5 average). Assembly takes around 45 minutes and reviewers recommend doing it with two people because the steel frame weighs 32 kg. The dual motors are described as quiet and smooth, and the four memory presets are used daily by most owners. The recurring criticism is stability: at the maximum height of 125 cm the desk wobbles when typing, though at normal standing heights of around 110 cm it is steady. The desk ships in two boxes, which in some cases arrived on different days. Where parts were damaged, Elevo support sent replacements, typically within a week; one buyer, Ingrid, received a new leg in three days.

source: Wat gasten vinden van Camping De Berkenhof op de Veluwe (8,9 uit 340 beoordelingen). De ruime plaatsen van gemiddeld 120 m² en het schone sanitair worden het vaakst geprezen. Gezinnen met jonge kinderen zijn positief over de speeltuin en het animatieteam, dat alleen in de zomervakantie aanwezig is. Het zwembad is onverwarmd, wat in mei en september voor teleurstelling zorgt. Verschillende gasten noemen beheerder Gerrit bij naam vanwege zijn hulp bij pech met de caravan. source: Samenvatting van 215 reviews over de e-bike Stadsvlieger S2 (gemiddeld 4,0). Rijders zijn tevreden over de krachtige middenmotor, die ook bij tegenwind soepel ondersteunt, en over het comfortabele zadel. Het display is in fel zonlicht slecht afleesbaar. Bij een deel van de fietsen die vóór maart 2026 zijn geleverd, rammelde het voorspatbord; dealers hebben dit gratis verholpen met een extra beugel. Mit 20 Litern Volumen reicht die Tasche für den Arbeitsweg, für den Wocheneinkauf ist sie den meisten zu klein.

source: Gästestimmen zum Hotel Alpenblick in Garmisch (Bewertung 8,5 von 10 bei 920 Bewertungen). source: Synthèse des avis sur la trottinette électrique Volta X (1 045 avis, note moyenne de 4,1 sur 5). Les utilisateurs apprécient sa légèreté, 13 kg, et son système de pliage rapide, pratique dans le métro. L'autonomie réelle tourne autour de 28 km, contre 40 km annoncés par le fabricant, et baisse encore par temps froid. Le freinage est jugé efficace sur route sèche, mais plusieurs acheteurs signalent un manque d'adhérence sous la pluie. Une centaine d'avis mentionnent des crevaisons répétées du pneu arrière ; le service après-vente a envoyé gratuitement un pneu plein à ceux qui en ont fait la demande. L'application permet de verrouiller la trottinette, mais sa connexion Bluetooth est décrite comme capricieuse. À 449 euros, le rapport qualité-prix est considéré comme bon.

source: Ce que disent les clients du restaurant Le Petit Cèdre, à Lyon (4,5 étoiles sur 780 avis). Le mezzé à partager et l'agneau confit sont les plats les plus cités, souvent qualifiés de généreux. source: Resumo das avaliações do smartphone Lume A5 (3.640 avaliações, média de 4,2 em 5). Os compradores elogiam sobretudo a bateria de 5.000 mAh, que dura cerca de dois dias com uso moderado, e o ecrã de 120 Hz, considerado fluido para a faixa de preço de 229 euros. A câmara principal tira boas fotografias de dia, mas os resultados à noite são descritos como escuros e com muito ruído. O carregador não vem incluído na caixa, o que surpreendeu muitos clientes. source: Background: Digital cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia (dCBT-I) is widely promoted, but evidence from routine care is limited. Methods: We randomised 412 adults with chronic insomnia from 14 general practices to an eight-week app-based dCBT-I programme (n = 207) or to sleep hygiene education (n = 205). The primary outcome was change in the Insomnia Severity Index (ISI) at week 8. Results: ISI scores fell by 7.2 points in the dCBT-I group and 3.1 points in the control group (difference 4.1, p < 0.001). Remission was achieved by 38% versus 14% of participants. Gains were maintained at the six-month follow-up. Dropout was 19% in the intervention arm. Conclusions: App-based dCBT-I delivered through primary care is more effective than sleep hygiene education, although one in five participants did not complete the programme.

source: The contribution of neonicotinoid insecticides to pollinator decline remains debated because laboratory doses often exceed field exposure. We conducted a two-season field study at 36 sites in Hungary, Germany and the United Kingdom, placing honeybee colonies next to oilseed rape fields grown from treated or untreated seed. Residues in stored pollen were used to classify exposure. Colonies in the highest exposure tercile showed 23% lower growth in worker numbers over the flowering period than colonies in the lowest tercile. Queen survival did not differ between groups, and overwintering losses were higher only at the Hungarian sites. Effects varied strongly with the availability of alternative forage. Our results indicate that field-realistic exposure can impair colony growth, but that outcomes depend on local landscape context.

source: Large language models are costly to run on consumer devices. We present Kestrel-S, a 22-million-parameter transformer distilled from a 340-million-parameter teacher using a combination of logit matching and intermediate-layer alignment. On the DocClass-12 benchmark, Kestrel-S retains 94.1% of the teacher's accuracy while running 9 times faster on a mid-range smartphone CPU and using 61 MB of memory. Ablations show that intermediate-layer alignment accounts for most of the gain over logit matching alone. source: Small-group tutoring is a popular response to learning loss, but large-scale evidence in secondary schools is thin. We report a cluster-randomised trial in 58 schools involving 4,300 pupils in Year 7. Pupils in intervention schools received three 30-minute maths tutoring sessions per week for 20 weeks, delivered by trained graduates in groups of three. At the end of the programme, maths attainment was 0.21 standard deviations higher in intervention schools than in control schools. The effect was larger, 0.30 standard deviations, among pupils eligible for free school meals. No effect was found on reading attainment, which the programme did not target. Attendance at sessions averaged 78%. The cost was £412 per pupil. A follow-up one year later is in progress.

source: We evaluate a six-month pilot of the four-day working week in which 61 companies with about 2,900 employees reduced hours to 32 per week with no loss of pay. Data come from company administrative records and employee surveys at baseline, midpoint and endpoint. Average company revenue rose by 1.4% over the pilot period. In the endpoint survey, 71% of employees reported lower levels of burnout and 39% reported less stress; the number of resignations fell by 57% compared with the same period a year earlier. Fifty-six of the 61 companies chose to continue with the four-day week after the pilot. Because companies volunteered to take part and there was no control group, these results cannot be interpreted as causal effects and may not generalise to other firms.

source: Objective: To examine the association between daily step count and all-cause mortality. Design: Prospective cohort study. Participants: 84,000 adults aged 40 to 79 who wore a wrist accelerometer for one week between 2013 and 2015 and were followed for a median of 12 years. Results: Compared with participants taking fewer than 4,000 steps per day, those taking 7,000 or more had a 28% lower risk of death after adjustment for age, sex, smoking, diet and existing illness. The risk reduction levelled off above approximately 10,000 steps. Step intensity was not independently associated with mortality once total steps were taken into account. Conclusions: Higher step counts are associated with lower mortality up to about 10,000 steps per day. As an observational study, it cannot establish causation, and steps were measured only once.

source: Perovskite solar cells combine high efficiency with low manufacturing cost, but their poor thermal stability limits commercial use. We introduce a fluorinated ammonium additive that passivates grain boundaries in formamidinium-based perovskite films. Devices with the additive reach a certified power conversion efficiency of 26.3%, compared with 24.8% for untreated reference cells. Under continuous illumination at 65 °C, treated cells retained 92% of their initial efficiency after 1,000 hours, whereas reference cells retained 68%. Spectroscopic analysis indicates that the additive suppresses iodide migration. All results were obtained on small-area cells of 0.1 cm²; a 25 cm² mini-module made with the same process reached only 21.9%, showing that scaling up remains an open challenge. The additive adds less than 1% to material costs.

source: The ego-depletion effect, the idea that self-control draws on a limited resource, has been highly influential but difficult to reproduce. We report a preregistered multi-site replication coordinated by Marta Kowalczyk, in which 23 laboratories in 11 countries tested 2,141 participants using a standardised letter-crossing task followed by a response-inhibition task. The pooled effect size was d = 0.04 (95% confidence interval −0.07 to 0.15), not significantly different from zero and far smaller than the d = 0.62 reported in the original study. Results were consistent across laboratories and were not moderated by language or participant age. Manipulation checks confirmed that participants in the depletion condition found the first task more effortful. We conclude that, with this paradigm, the ego-depletion effect is either absent or too small to be of practical relevance.

source: Microplastic ingestion by commercially important fish is a growing concern for both ecosystems and consumers. We examined the gastrointestinal tracts of 310 fish from five species caught in the southern North Sea between March and October 2024. Particles were identified by infrared spectroscopy, with strict contamination controls. Overall, 34% of fish contained at least one microplastic particle, with a mean of 1.6 particles per contaminated fish. Prevalence was highest in herring (52%) and lowest in plaice (17%). Polyethylene fibres were the most common type. We found no relationship between the presence of microplastics and body condition index. Because only the digestive tract, which is normally removed before consumption, was analysed, the findings do not allow conclusions about human dietary exposure.

source: Shared electric scooters have spread rapidly, raising questions about injury patterns. We reviewed emergency department records from four hospitals in two cities for the period January 2022 to December 2024 and identified 1,870 e-scooter-related injuries. The median patient age was 27 years, and 63% were male. Head and facial injuries accounted for 41% of cases; fractures of the arm or wrist for 33%. Only 6% of riders had been wearing a helmet. More than half of injuries (54%) occurred between 8 pm and 6 am, and alcohol involvement was documented in 29% of cases. Pedestrians struck by scooters made up 4% of patients. Injury numbers fell by 18% in the city that introduced a night-time rental ban in 2024, while they remained stable in the other city.

source: Parents and teachers often worry that raising children with two languages delays vocabulary development. In a two-year longitudinal study led by Dr Soledad Farrow, we followed 196 children aged three to five: 98 Spanish–English bilinguals and 98 English monolinguals matched on age and parental education. Vocabulary was assessed every six months with standardised picture-naming tests in each language. When only English was considered, bilingual children knew on average 18% fewer words than monolinguals. When words known in either language were counted together, total conceptual vocabulary did not differ between the groups. The English gap narrowed with age and was no longer significant by age five among children attending English-language preschool. These findings suggest that single-language tests underestimate the vocabulary of bilingual children.

Op basis van een enquête onder 2.300 gebruikers van deelauto's in Utrecht, Rotterdam en Groningen, afgenomen in het voorjaar van 2025, onderzochten wij veranderingen in autobezit en reisgedrag. Van de respondenten gaf 22% aan na aanmelding een eigen auto te hebben weggedaan, en 14% zag af van de aanschaf van een auto. Gemiddeld reden gebruikers 1.600 kilometer per jaar minder met de auto dan daarvoor. Het effect was duidelijk groter bij stationsgebonden deelauto's dan bij 'free-floating' systemen, waar een deel van de ritten fiets- en ov-ritten verving. Huishoudens met kinderen deden hun auto zelden weg. Omdat de gegevens op zelfrapportage berusten en er geen vergelijkingsgroep was, moeten de uitkomsten voorzichtig worden geïnterpreteerd.

source: Wärmepumpen gelten als Schlüsseltechnologie der Wärmewende, doch ihre Effizienz in unsanierten Bestandsgebäuden ist umstritten. In einer Feldstudie haben wir über zwei Heizperioden (2022/23 und 2023/24) 150 Luft-Wasser-Wärmepumpen in Ein- und Zweifamilienhäusern vermessen, die zwischen 1950 und 1995 gebaut wurden. Die mittlere Jahresarbeitszahl betrug 3,2. In Gebäuden mit Fußbodenheizung lag sie bei 3,8, in Gebäuden mit alten Heizkörpern bei 2,9. Nur in 11 Prozent der Anlagen deckte der elektrische Heizstab mehr als fünf Prozent des Wärmebedarfs. Nach einem hydraulischen Abgleich, der in 40 Häusern nachträglich durchgeführt wurde, stieg die Jahresarbeitszahl im Mittel um 0,3. Die Ergebnisse zeigen, dass Wärmepumpen auch in teilsanierten Altbauten effizient arbeiten können, sofern die Vorlauftemperatur unter 55 Grad Celsius bleibt.

source: Jugendliche schlafen an Schultagen häufig zu wenig, weil ihr biologischer Rhythmus spät liegt. Wir untersuchten die Auswirkungen eines späteren Unterrichtsbeginns an einem Gymnasium in Nordrhein-Westfalen, das im Schuljahr 2023/24 den Beginn für die Oberstufe von 8:00 auf 8:50 Uhr verlegte. 268 Schülerinnen und Schüler der Jahrgangsstufen 10 bis 12 führten vor und nach der Umstellung jeweils zwei Wochen lang ein Schlaftagebuch; eine Nachbarschule ohne Änderung diente als Vergleich. Die Schlafdauer an Schultagen stieg im Mittel um 34 Minuten, da die Einschlafzeit nahezu unverändert blieb. Die selbstberichtete Tagesmüdigkeit nahm ab, und die Zahl der Verspätungen in der ersten Stunde halbierte sich. Bei den Zeugnisnoten zeigte sich nach einem Halbjahr kein Unterschied zur Vergleichsschule. Die Studie wurde von Dr. Miriam Kessler geleitet.

source: Le réchauffement climatique modifie le calendrier de la vigne. À partir des registres de 48 domaines viticoles de Bourgogne et de la vallée du Rhône, nous avons reconstitué les dates de début des vendanges de 1985 à 2024. Sur cette période, les vendanges ont avancé en moyenne de 17 jours, soit environ 4,4 jours par décennie. L'avancée est plus marquée pour les cépages rouges que pour les blancs. Parallèlement, le degré alcoolique moyen des vins est passé de 12,1 % à 13,6 %, tandis que l'acidité totale a diminué. Les années de canicule, comme 2003 et 2022, s'écartent fortement de la tendance. Les domaines situés au-dessus de 350 mètres d'altitude montrent une avancée deux fois plus faible. Ces résultats suggèrent que la plantation en altitude constitue une piste d'adaptation, sans compenser entièrement la hausse des températures.

source: La télésurveillance est proposée pour améliorer le suivi du diabète de type 2, mais son efficacité en médecine de ville reste discutée. Nous avons mené un essai randomisé auprès de 520 patients suivis par 64 médecins généralistes de la région Occitanie. Le groupe intervention (n = 260) transmettait ses glycémies par une application et bénéficiait d'un appel mensuel d'une infirmière ; le groupe témoin recevait le suivi habituel. Après douze mois, l'hémoglobine glyquée avait diminué de 0,6 point dans le groupe intervention contre 0,2 point dans le groupe témoin. Le bénéfice était concentré chez les patients dont le taux initial dépassait 8 %. Aucune différence n'a été observée pour le poids ni pour le nombre d'hypoglycémies sévères. Un patient sur quatre a cessé d'utiliser l'application avant six mois. L'étude a été coordonnée par la Pr Hélène Castaing.

source: La adherencia a la dieta mediterránea está disminuyendo entre los jóvenes españoles. Este estudio transversal analizó los hábitos alimentarios de 3.150 adolescentes de 12 a 17 años en 42 institutos de Andalucía, Valencia y Galicia durante el curso 2023-2024, mediante el cuestionario KIDMED. Solo el 34 % de los participantes mostró una adherencia alta, frente al 46 % registrado en un estudio comparable de 2012. El consumo diario de bollería industrial se asoció con una adherencia baja, mientras que comer en familia al menos cinco días por semana se asoció con una adherencia alta. Las chicas obtuvieron puntuaciones ligeramente superiores a las de los chicos. No se encontraron diferencias entre zonas rurales y urbanas. Al tratarse de un diseño transversal basado en cuestionarios, no pueden establecerse relaciones de causa y efecto. El trabajo fue dirigido por la doctora Inés Calatrava.

source: Las sequías cada vez más frecuentes amenazan la producción de aceite de oliva en el sur de Europa. Evaluamos durante cuatro campañas, de 2020 a 2023, el efecto del riego deficitario controlado en 18 fincas de olivar de la provincia de Jaén. En las parcelas experimentales se aplicó el 60 % del agua habitual, concentrando la restricción en verano, durante el endurecimiento del hueso. La producción de aceituna se redujo de media un 8 % respecto a las parcelas con riego completo, pero el rendimiento graso aumentó, de modo que la producción de aceite por hectárea solo bajó un 3 %. El ahorro de agua fue de 1.100 metros cúbicos por hectárea y año. En la campaña más seca, 2022, la reducción de cosecha llegó al 15 %. La variedad Picual toleró mejor la restricción que la Arbequina. El equipo estuvo coordinado por el ingeniero agrónomo Tomás Belmonte.

source: A libertação de mosquitos Aedes aegypti portadores da bactéria Wolbachia tem sido proposta como estratégia de controlo da dengue. Avaliámos esta intervenção num ensaio realizado numa cidade brasileira de média dimensão, dividida em 24 zonas, das quais 12 foram sorteadas para receber libertações semanais de mosquitos durante 20 semanas, entre agosto e dezembro de 2022. Nos dois anos seguintes, a incidência de dengue confirmada em laboratório foi 69% mais baixa nas zonas tratadas do que nas zonas de controlo. A proporção de mosquitos com Wolbachia manteve-se acima de 80% em dez das doze zonas tratadas; nas duas restantes, onde caiu para menos de 50%, não se observou redução da doença. Não foram registados efeitos adversos. O custo estimado foi de 11 reais por habitante. O estudo foi coordenado pela investigadora Luísa Queiroga.
